title: Final Reflection Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the amplitude reflection coefficient r_p.

title: Final Transmission Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the amplitude transmission coefficient t_p.

title: Final Reflection Coefficient (s)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the amplitude reflection coefficient r_s.

title: Final Transmission Coefficient (s)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the amplitude transmission coefficient t_s.

title: Brewster's Law
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive Brewster's law correctly as a special case of the Fresnel equations.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the boundary conditions for electric and magnetic fields at the interface.

title: Snell's Law Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Snell's law in the derivation process.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may make common sign errors in the reflection and transmission coefficients.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may omit necessary factors in the final expressions for r_p, t_p, r_s, and t_s.
